crew.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.
crew.title: The Conjuring

crew.overview: In the years before the Second World War, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.
crew.title: The Sound of Music

crew.overview: During China's Warring States period, a district prefect arrives at the palace of Qin Shi Huang, claiming to have killed the three assassins who had made an attempt on the king's life three years ago.
crew.title: Hero

crew.overview: Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits.
crew.title: The Conjuring 2

crew.overview: A family discovers that dark spirits have invaded their home after their son inexplicably falls into an endless sleep. When they reach out to a professional for help, they learn things are a lot more personal than they thought.
crew.title: Insidious

crew.overview: Two men wake up to find themselves shackled in a grimy, abandoned bathroom. As they struggle to comprehend their predicament, they discover a disturbing tape left behind by the sadistic mastermind known as Jigsaw. With a chilling voice and cryptic instructions, Jigsaw informs them that they must partake in a gruesome game in order to secure their freedom.
crew.title: Saw

details.biography: As a veteran finish colorist in post-production, his aesthetics and appreciation of the cinematographer's craft have allowed him to collaborate with filmmakers such as James Wan on "Aquaman" and "The Conjuring" universe of films. Those experiences on new films also honed his eye for color and expertise, entrusting him with historically vital restorations including "My Fair Lady", "The Sound of Music" and "Oklahoma", to name a few. Originally from Chicago, he moved to Toronto and sharpened his skills on look-driven, high-end auto, fashion, food, and sports campaigns, often heavy with multi-layered VFX. His success as a top commercial colorist in Toronto for broadcast television advertising led him to Los Angeles where he flourished in all aspects of color correction; from award-winning commercials to trailers, episodic television and feature films.
details.name: Mark Griffith
